context: A cardboard box on 42nd St. A crowd. A dealer with fast hands.

lines.speaker: npc.deuce_crowd
lines.text: Find the lady, find the lady, red wins, black loses, find the lady!

lines.speaker: npc.deuce_crowd
lines.text: Ooh, so close! Again? Again's free. No it isn't.

lines.speaker: npc.deuce_crowd
lines.text: Hey! That guy works for him! The one in the hat! He wins every time!

lines.speaker: npc.deuce_crowd
lines.text: Cops! Box up, box up, see you on Forty-First!
